# ACME Global - Company Policies & Benefits

## 1. Remote and Flexible Work Policy
Employees at ACME Global enjoy a flexible hybrid working model.
- **Core Working Hours**: All teams must be reachable during core collaboration hours between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM local time.
- **Remote Days**: Team members can work up to 3 days remotely per week. Full-remote exceptions require approval from department heads.

## 2. Paid Time Off (PTO) and Leaves
- **Vacation Time**: Full-time employees accrue 25 paid vacation days per calendar year.
- **Rollover**: Up to 5 unused PTO days can be rolled over to the following year. Unused rollover days expire on March 31st.
- **Wellness Days**: ACME observes 4 company-wide "Recharge Days" each quarter, granting an extra paid day off for physical and mental rest.

- **Medical, Dental, and Vision**: 100% employer-covered premiums for employees and 80% coverage for dependents.

# ACME Global - Engineering Handbook & Technical Standards

## 1. Code Review & Pull Request Standards
- **Reviewers**: Every pull request (PR) requires at least two peer approvals before merging to `main`.
- **Test Coverage**: All new features and bugfixes must include automated unit or integration tests. Overall test coverage threshold is maintained at 80% or higher.
- **PR Description**: Each PR must document:
  1. The problem being solved (referencing a Jira or GitHub ticket).
  2. The architectural approach taken.

## 2. Release & Deployment Cadence
- **Sprints**: Engineering operates on 2-week agile sprints ending every other Wednesday.
- **Deployment Windows**: Production releases occur on Tuesday and Thursday mornings at 10:00 AM UTC.
- **Deployment Freezes**: We maintain a strict "No-Deploy Friday" policy. Emergency hotfixes on Fridays require explicit sign-off from the VP of Engineering or on-call Incident Commander.

## 3. Incident Management & Severity Levels
- **SEV-1 (Critical)**: Complete outage or critical data breach affecting > 5% of active users.
  - On-call acknowledgment SLA: Under 5 minutes.
  - Mitigation target: Under 30 minutes.
  - Post-Mortem: Blameless post-mortem document completed within 48 hours.
- **SEV-2 (Major)**: Degraded functionality for important features with no immediate workaround.
  - Acknowledgment SLA: Under 15 minutes.

# ACME Global - Travel & Expense Reimbursement Policy

## 1. Flight and Transportation Bookings
- **Advance Booking**: All flight bookings should be made at least 14 days in advance through Navan (corporate travel portal).
- **Cabin Class Policy**:
  - Flights under 6 hours: Economy or Premium Economy class only.
  - Flights over 6 continuous hours (transcontinental or international): Business class is permitted with manager approval.

## 1. Flight and Transportation Bookings
- **Advance Booking**: All flight bookings should be made at least 14 days in advance through Navan (corporate travel portal).
- **Cabin Class Policy**:
  - Flights under 6 hours: Economy or Premium Economy class only.
  - Flights over 6 continuous hours (transcontinental or international): Business class is permitted with manager approval.

## 2. Daily Per Diem & Meals
- **Domestic Travel (US & Canada)**: Up to \$85 per full day for meals (breakfast \$20, lunch \$25, dinner \$40).
- **International Travel**: Up to \$110 per full day.
- **Alcohol**: Alcoholic beverages consumed during individual travel are not reimbursable. Team dinners or client entertainment meals allow moderate alcohol with Director approval.

## 3. Expense Submission Deadlines & Receipts
- **Filing Window**: All travel and business expenses must be submitted within 30 calendar days following the conclusion of the trip.
- **Receipts**: Itemized digital receipts are mandatory for all transactions exceeding \$25 USD.
- **Payment Method**: Corporate credit cards are issued to employees who travel more than twice annually. Personal cards may be used and reimbursed within two pay cycles.
